articles.title: Olivia Rodrigo's Unraveled Tour: How to Snag Tickets Before They Vanish
articles.summary: Olivia Rodrigo's Unraveled Tour kicks off this fall with 50+ U.S. dates. Tickets are nearly sold out, but third-party sites still have seats starting at $141.

articles.title: Denim Sculptures That Unravel the American Dream
articles.summary: Nick Doyle's denim wall sculptures explore the contradictions of American mythology—from cowboy ruggedness to slavery's legacy. On view in NYC through May 30.

articles.title: Peso Pluma Makes Surprise Appearance at CUNY's First Mexican-American Graduation
articles.summary: Peso Pluma surprised nearly 200 graduates at CUNY's first Mexican-American commencement, celebrating cultural identity and educational equity.
